disposition_reason: Seven imported instant-noodle brands bought monthly for four months at four Windhoek outlets (48 samples) were analysed by ICP-OES for Zn, Cd, Cu, Pb and As; per outlet-brand values (n=3 replicates) and period means are printed.

study.design: retail survey, 4 outlets x brands x 4 monthly periods
study.origin: produced in Thailand, China or South Africa; packed in Thailand, South Africa or China (Table 1)
study.market: four commercial outlets in Katutura, CBD, Monte Christo and Khomasdal, Windhoek, Namibia
study.period_text: four monthly sampling periods (I-IV); calendar dates not stated
study.method: whole noodle cake ground and sieved, aqua regia digestion, ICP-OES (8000 series)
study.lod_text: not stated; values printed as '<0.05' and 'ND' (mg/kg)
study.qa: not reported (no CRM, recovery or blanks described)
